validation.privacyReview: whitelist export; no source paths, filenames, URLs, or person identifiers

caveats: The epa-drift valid protocol remains a verification candidate; this export is not a final protocol certification.
Reported values may summarize multiple runs. Their run-level aggregation and evaluated trajectory intervals are not established here.
n counts finite reported sequences, not successful runs, attempts, or temporal coverage. N_report counts report headers; planned N is unverified.
Finite starred values contribute. One star means one mid-run failure, two mean two, and three mean all runs failed mid-run with attempt count unspecified.
NR means no configuration records. An unmarked dash means no result from the outset; a starred dash retains its separate mid-run failure annotation.
Historical run-to-code linkage is not established for all source values. Input variant and platform are not specified in these trajectory tables.
ROVIO, DM-VIO, and AirSLAM mode labels are supported by audited code but await confirmation against original runs; their raw mode remains unspecified.
Dataset means use all finite sequence contributors for each configuration. Unequal contributor sets can affect comparisons; inspect the sequence ledger.
